topics.title: Numbers & Number Operations
topics.description: Master integers, place values, prime factorization, non-decimal bases, index laws, fractions, and standard form.

topics.title: Fractions, Decimals & Percentages
topics.description: Master operations on proper/improper fractions, decimal rounding, percentage change, and recurring decimals.

topics.title: Ratio, Proportion & Financial Math
topics.description: Master unit rates, proportional sharing, speed/travel graphs, simple interest, taxes, and compound rates.

topics.title: Sets & Venn Diagrams
topics.description: Master listing elements, set builder notation, union, intersection, complement, and universal two-set Venn diagrams.

topics.title: Patterns & Algebraic Expressions
topics.description: Master foundational algebraic substitution, pairwise grouping factorization, fractional expansion, and change of subject.

topics.title: Equations, Inequalities & Coordinate Graphs
topics.description: Master linear equations in one and two variables, linear inequalities on number lines, Cartesian plotting, and linear mappings.

topics.title: Geometry, Measurement & Trigonometry
topics.description: Master angle properties, polygon interior angles, Pythagorean theorem, perimeter, area, volume, and compass bearings.

topics.title: Handling Data & Probability
topics.description: Master frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, mean, median, mode, stem-and-leaf, and experimental/theoretical probability.
